rows.note: Use this for real-life trouble, controversy, or interpersonal upheaval rather than a theatrical work.

example.english: The drama over this online incident is really getting bigger and bigger.
example.traditional: 今次網上嗰場風波真係越鬧越大。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 mong5 soeng6 go2 coeng4 fung1 bo1 zan1 hai6 jyut6 naau6 jyut6 daai6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a television drama, especially a dramatic series.

example.english: Every episode of this TV drama is so tense.
example.traditional: 呢套電視劇每集都咁緊張。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 din6 si6 kek6 mui5 zaap6 dou1 gam3 gan2 zoeng1

rows.note: Use 戲劇 as the all-purpose term for drama as a genre or theatrical work, including non-comedy film and radio drama.

example.english: I've loved watching drama since I was little.
example.traditional: 我細個已經好鍾意睇戲劇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 ji5 ging1 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 hei3 kek6

rows.note: Use this when referring to the written script or play text itself rather than the dramatic genre.

example.english: This drama script is beautifully nuanced.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 kek6 bun2 se2 dak1 hou2 sai3 nei6
